main_result.title: Predictably weighted process reliability admits an exact denominator-envelope e-process that recovers the original equal-weight construction and weakly dominates the earlier conservative weighted prototype.
main_result.setup: For Y_i in [0,1], predictable 0<w_i<=1, and mu_i=E[Y_i|F_{i-1}], target m=sum w_i mu_i / sum w_i.
main_result.component_supermartingale: For fixed lambda, M_t=prod exp(-lambda w_i Y_i)/(1-(1-exp(-lambda w_i))*mu_i) is nonnegative supermartingale.
main_result.exact_denominator_envelope: D_max(m)=max prod_i(1-a_i mu_i) over 0<=mu_i<=1 and sum_i w_i mu_i=Wm, a_i=1-exp(-lambda w_i). Then E_lambda(m)=exp(-lambda sum_i w_iY_i)/D_max(m) is pathwise <=M_t at the true weighted average, so any fixed lambda mixture is Ville-valid.
main_result.water_filling: Because sum log(1-a_i mu_i) is concave, the KKT solution has mu_i=clip(1/a_i-c/w_i,0,1) for one scalar c selected to meet the weighted-mean constraint. Breakpoints are c=w_i/a_i and c=w_i(1-a_i)/a_i.
main_result.equal_weight_recovery: When all weights equal 1, Jensen makes mu_i=m at the maximizing denominator and D_max=(1-(1-exp(-lambda))*m)^t exactly, so this is a strict generalization of the prior equal-process rare-mismatch CS rather than a separate approximation.

finite_synthetic_gain.interpretation: The gain is modest in these tested patterns, but exact weighting removes an avoidable approximation and is exactly as tight as the original method when weights become equal.

main_result.design_preference: If request/exposure weighting is required and operationally possible, prospectively fixed equal-size exposure blocks remain preferable: they avoid outcome-dependent realized-size weighting and use the simpler exact equal-weight construction. The exact weighted envelope is a fallback for genuinely unequal predictable exposure weights.

measurement_validity_rules: The statistical weight must be fixed before the current score/outcome. Do not substitute realized process size if process duration/size can react to the outcome.
Normalize exposure weights using a predeclared cap. Cap exceedance requires fail-closed handling or a separately declared generation, not retrospective renormalization.
Equal-process reliability and request/exposure-weighted reliability are different estimands; never compare their upper bounds as though they estimated the same quantity.
For the time-varying weighted average conditional mean, do not running-intersect endpoints across times without a separate constant-target theorem.
Use the exact envelope when unequal predictable weights materially matter; retain the conservative prototype as an independently simple fallback/check.
scope_guards: The exact denominator optimization is a mathematical envelope under the stated bounded/predictable-weight assumptions; production implementation performance is unmeasured.
Synthetic process-count examples are not production mismatch or latency measurements.
No claim is made against all importance-weighted or self-normalized confidence-sequence methods outside this contract.
No forbidden semantic inputs were read.

frontier.action: Implement an efficient breakpoint/water-filling exact weighted endpoint and cross-check it against brute-force convex optimization on random small weight vectors; add fail-closed monotonicity tests.

Formalize prospective equal-size exposure blockization when process termination is adaptive, and identify whether the target is the average over observed blocks or a larger counterfactual exposure population.
Compare the exact weighted envelope with public importance-weighted/time-uniform methods under the same predictable-weight estimand rather than generic width.
Build the lifetime-valid fingerprint generation/lease state machine using average-conditional-mean inference by default and stable-p only under independently justified constancy.
Continue public trace search for token-to-score/sign propagation under repeated inference.

exact_next_action: Implement and validate the exact water-filling weighted endpoint with randomized small-instance checks against direct constrained optimization, then benchmark runtime and interval gain before promoting it beyond research prototype.
